description: This PHP source file defines the ImportViewConfirm class, which handles the user interface and logic for confirming import details in the SuiteCRM import module. It includes methods for rendering the confirmation page, processing uploaded files, detecting CSV properties, managing import mappings, and displaying errors.

classes.name: ImportViewConfirm
classes.description: Handles display and processing of the confirmation step in the import process, including file handling, property detection, mapping, and error reporting.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to render the confirmation page with import details, handle file uploads, and initialize import settings.

methods.name: getDelimeterOptions
methods.description: Returns HTML options for selecting CSV delimiter.

methods.name: getEnclosureOptions
methods.description: Returns HTML options for selecting CSV enclosure characters.

methods.name: overloadImportFileMapFromRequest
methods.description: Overrides import file mapping settings based on user form input.

methods.name: shouldAutoDetectProperties
methods.description: Determines whether to automatically detect CSV properties based on import source.

methods.name: getImportMap
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an import mapping seed based on source.

methods.name: setNumberFormatOptions
methods.description: Sets number formatting options from user preferences or locale.

methods.name: setCurrencyOptions
methods.description: Configures currency selection options and related JavaScript.

methods.name: setDateTimeProperties
methods.description: Sets date, time, and timezone options for import.

methods.name: setImportFileCharacterSet
methods.description: Determines and sets character encoding options for import files.

methods.name: getImportMappingJS
methods.description: Loads available import mapping scripts for JavaScript use.

methods.name: getMaxColumnsInSampleSet
methods.description: Calculates maximum number of columns in a sample CSV set.

methods.name: getSampleSet
methods.description: Retrieves a sample subset of rows from the uploaded file for preview.

methods.name: _getJS
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for the import confirmation page, including event handlers and dynamic UI behavior.

methods.name: _showImportError
methods.description: Displays an error message using Smarty templates during import process.
